system.story: The widest fleet - the purest expression of the rigger pet class.

description.value:
Subclass: Drone (Swarm-Master). You field the widest fleet of any Wrench - the purest expression of the rigger "pet class."

Identity Feature - Wide Band

You may keep more drones fielded at once than the baseline cap and command the whole fleet with a single Deploy & Command maneuver; your fielded-fleet Uptime drip counts each drone. The most machine bodies on the board.

Signature Tweak

Your Focus Fire with three or more drones adds an automatic auto-suppress rider on the target.

Bonus Skill + Contact

A second rigging/fabrication skill, plus a contact: a fellow rigger or drone-broker (a bound spotter drone as a retainer-style follower).
